{
  "analysis": "Interesting — with the default CPU (no `-cpu 486`), the CPU is now in 32-bit protected mode at EIP=0x80078800 (SeaBIOS), and the debug log shows execution at 0x00108354 (DOS boot area), meaning the boot sector is being executed. The CPU is making progress but the screen remains black. This suggests a VGA display issue with QEMU 8.2.2's SeaVGABIOS, not a CPU/boot issue. Let me wait longer and try a different approach.",
  "plan": "Wait 30 more seconds to let DOS boot, then take another screenshot. If still black, kill QEMU and try with `-vga std` and default machine type (no deprecated machine). If that doesn't work either, we'll install QEMU 5.2.0 from source.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "sleep 30
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import socket, time, re
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock')
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
# Check if CPU is progressing
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r1 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')
eip1 = re.search(r'EIP=([0-9a-f]+)', r1)
time.sleep(1)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r2 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')
eip2 = re.search(r'EIP=([0-9a-f]+)', r2)
hlt = 'HLT=1' in r1
print(f"EIP 1: {eip1.group(1) if eip1 else 'N/A'}, EIP 2: {eip2.group(1) if eip2 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"Progressing: {eip1 and eip2 and eip1.group(1) != eip2.group(1)}, HLT: {hlt}")
s.sendall(b'screendump /tmp/qemu-screen7.ppm\n')
time.sleep(0.5)
s.recv(4096)
s.close()
PYEOF
python3 -c "
with open('/tmp/qemu-screen7.ppm','rb') as f:
    f.readline(); dims = f.readline().strip(); f.readline(); data = f.read()
    w, h = map(int, dims.split())
    non_black = sum(1 for i in range(0, len(data), 3) if data[i] > 30 or data[i+1] > 30 or data[i+2] > 30)
    print(f'Dimensions: {w}x{h}, Non-black: {non_black} ({100*non_black/(w*h):.1f}%)')
"
tail -20 /tmp/qemu-debug.log
",
      "duration": 40.0
    }
  ]
}
